svg.title: Five configuration decisions, 68x throughput
svg.desc: Five numbered serving configurations as boxes with proportional throughput bars beside them, climbing from a model loaded inside the handler at 2.3 requests per second and a p99 of 1,840 milliseconds, through an async def that blocks the event loop at 43, a threadpool fighting itself at 58, four uvicorn workers at 97 with p99 61 milliseconds, to micro-batching at 156 with p99 94; the first three are struck through and annotated with the specific mistake, and a bottom row contrasts liveness and readiness endpoints with a database-checking readiness probe crossed out.
svg.text: 380 ms of the 402 is loading the model.
async def + a blocking call = the event
loop stops. One request at a time,
40 threads x 4 OMP threads on 4 vCPU.
one process per core, one thread each.
throughput up 61%, p99 up 54%. This is
...and when 4 vCPU is not enough? -> Week 24
